body_markdown:
# Introduction

Question-and-answer practice helps you respond more naturally in English. The answers below are examples. Change names, places, times and personal details to make them true for you.

## 1. Introductions

1. **What is your name?** — My name is Rahul.
2. **Where are you from?** — I am from Maharashtra.
3. **Where do you live?** — I live in Pune.
4. **What do you do?** — I work in an office.
5. **How old are you?** — I am thirty years old.
6. **What languages do you speak?** — I speak Marathi, Hindi and some English.
7. **Are you a student?** — Yes, I am a student.
8. **What is your hometown?** — My hometown is Kolhapur.
9. **What is your nationality?** — I am Indian.
10. **Can you introduce yourself?** — My name is Rahul. I am from Maharashtra.

## 2. Family and home

11. **How many people are in your family?** — There are four people in my family.
12. **Do you live with your family?** — Yes, I do.
13. **Do you have any brothers or sisters?** — Yes, I have one sister.
14. **Who cooks at home?** — We share the cooking.
15. **What time do you have dinner?** — We usually have dinner at eight.
16. **Do you live in a house or a flat?** — I live in a flat.
17. **How many rooms are there?** — There are two bedrooms.
18. **Do you have a pet?** — No, I do not.
19. **Who is at home now?** — My parents are at home.
20. **Do you help with household work?** — Yes, I help with cleaning.

## 3. Daily routine

21. **What time do you wake up?** — I wake up at six.
22. **What do you do in the morning?** — I exercise and have breakfast.
23. **Do you drink tea or coffee?** — I usually drink tea.
24. **How do you travel to work?** — I travel by bus.
25. **What time do you start work?** — I start work at nine.
26. **When do you have lunch?** — I have lunch at one.
27. **What do you do after work?** — I return home and relax.
28. **Do you watch television?** — Sometimes I do.
29. **What time do you go to bed?** — I go to bed at ten.
30. **Are you busy today?** — Yes, I have a few tasks to complete.

## 4. Work and study

31. **Where do you work?** — I work at a hospital.
32. **What is your job?** — I work as a supervisor.
33. **Do you like your work?** — Yes, I enjoy learning new things.
34. **Who is your manager?** — My manager is Mr Patil.
35. **What are you working on?** — I am preparing a report.
36. **When is the meeting?** — The meeting is at eleven.
37. **Have you completed your work?** — Yes, I have completed it.
38. **Do you use a computer?** — Yes, I use a computer every day.
39. **What are you studying?** — I am studying English.
40. **Why are you learning English?** — I want to communicate confidently.

## 5. Likes and preferences

41. **What is your favourite food?** — My favourite food is dal and rice.
42. **Which colour do you like?** — I like blue.
43. **Do you like reading?** — Yes, I enjoy reading books.
44. **What kind of music do you like?** — I like soft music.
45. **Do you prefer tea or coffee?** — I prefer tea.
46. **What is your favourite sport?** — My favourite sport is cricket.
47. **Do you like travelling?** — Yes, I enjoy travelling.
48. **Which season do you prefer?** — I prefer the rainy season.
49. **What is your favourite subject?** — My favourite subject is English.
50. **What do you do for fun?** — I read and listen to music.

## 6. Time, place and directions

51. **What time is it?** — It is ten o'clock.
52. **What day is it today?** — It is Monday.
53. **Where is the bus stop?** — It is near the main road.
54. **How far is the station?** — It is about two kilometres away.
55. **How can I get there?** — You can take a bus.
56. **Is there a bank nearby?** — Yes, there is one near the market.
57. **Where are you going?** — I am going to the office.
58. **When will you return?** — I will return in the evening.
59. **Is this the right way?** — Yes, go straight ahead.
60. **Can I walk there?** — Yes, it is within walking distance.

## 7. Shopping and money

61. **How much is this?** — It costs 200 rupees.
62. **Do you have a larger size?** — Yes, we do.
63. **Can I pay by UPI?** — Yes, UPI is accepted.
64. **Do you need a bag?** — Yes, please.
65. **Can I get a receipt?** — Certainly.
66. **Is there a discount?** — Yes, there is a ten per cent discount.
67. **What would you like to buy?** — I would like to buy a notebook.
68. **Is this available in another colour?** — Yes, it is available in black.
69. **Can I exchange this item?** — Please check the store's exchange policy.
70. **Would you like anything else?** — No, thank you.

## 8. Health and well-being

71. **How are you feeling?** — I am feeling better.
72. **Are you feeling well?** — Yes, thank you.
73. **Do you need help?** — Yes, please.
74. **Where does it hurt?** — My shoulder hurts.
75. **Have you seen a doctor?** — Yes, I have.
76. **Are you taking any medicine?** — I am taking medicine prescribed by my doctor.
77. **Do you have an appointment?** — Yes, at four o'clock.
78. **Would you like some water?** — Yes, please.
79. **Are you tired?** — A little.
80. **Can I call someone for you?** — Yes, please call my family.

## 9. Plans and experiences

81. **What are you doing tomorrow?** — I am visiting my friend.
82. **Do you have any plans for Sunday?** — I plan to rest at home.
83. **Have you visited Mumbai?** — Yes, I have.
84. **Where did you go yesterday?** — I went to the market.
85. **Did you enjoy the trip?** — Yes, I enjoyed it.
86. **When will you start?** — I will start tomorrow.
87. **Would you like to join us?** — Yes, I would love to.
88. **Can we meet this evening?** — Yes, that works for me.
89. **How was your weekend?** — It was relaxing.
90. **What will you do next?** — I will finish my work.

## 10. Clarification and conversation

91. **Could you repeat that?** — Certainly. I will say it again.
92. **What do you mean?** — I mean that we should start early.
93. **Could you speak slowly?** — Of course.
94. **Do you understand?** — Yes, I understand.
95. **How do you spell that?** — It is spelled R-A-H-U-L.
96. **Can you help me?** — Yes, what do you need?
97. **May I ask a question?** — Certainly.
98. **Is everything ready?** — Yes, everything is ready.
99. **What happens next?** — We will check the details.
100. **Would you like to practise English together?** — Yes, that sounds great.

## Speaking practice

Choose ten questions from different sections. Answer without reading the sample. Give one extra detail with each answer. For example: “I travel by bus. It takes about thirty minutes.”

## Learning tip

The sample answers are not fixed responses. Use your own information and practise answering in complete sentences.

faq.question: Should I memorise all 100 answers?
faq.answer: No. Use the questions as speaking prompts and create answers that are true for you.

faq.question: How long should my answers be?
faq.answer: Start with one clear sentence. Add a reason or detail when you feel comfortable.

faq.question: How can I practise alone?
faq.answer: Read a question aloud, pause, answer without looking and record your response to review it.
